name: og-28-prebiotic-reaction-atlas
title: Prebiotic Reaction Atlas
claim: A versioned, provenance-tracked atlas of candidate prebiotic reactions — each with canonical species identities, a mass- and charge-balanced equation, a confidence tier (measured / inferred / hypothetical) and a kinetic domain — can connect C1–C3 carbon products to functional downstream chemistry while guaranteeing that no unbalanced or unsourced reaction ever enters an accepted model. The atlas's worth is measured by its coverage and the defensibility of its tiers, not by any single simulation.
question: Which measured or defensibly inferred reaction pathways connect C1–C3 products to functional chemistry, and with what confidence?
hypothesis: The primary literature plus curated reaction databases, filtered through balance, thermodynamic feasibility and kinetic-accessibility checks, yield a connected network from C1–C3 species to key functional products in which the measured-tier core is sparse but real, the inferred tier extends it under explicit thermodynamic/kinetic assumptions, and the hypothetical tier is flagged — and keeping these three tiers separate is precisely what stops enzyme-catalyzed or synthetic-only reactions from leaking into prebiotic models.
objective: Build and version the shared prebiotic-reaction-atlas (schema on PR #69): import/curate candidate reactions from Rhea/ChEBI/ORD plus primary-paper extraction, run deterministic chemistry validation (ChEBI identity, mass/charge balance, eQuilibrator ΔG), assign confidence tiers and kinetic domains, and expose the 28→29 transfer bundle.
proposed_mechanisms: separate reaction IDENTIFICATION (Rhea/ORD) from thermodynamic FEASIBILITY (eQuilibrator) from kinetic ACCESSIBILITY (rate form + domain) — never infer abiotic kinetics from enzyme catalysis
deterministic chemistry validation as a write-time gate into atlas.vN.jsonl
proposed_models_methods: Rhea + ChEBI canonical identities & balanced reaction definitions
ORD structured organic-reaction evidence; RDKit structure/reaction validation + precursor enumeration [to-build: viva_reaction_atlas]
eQuilibrator component-contribution ΔG feasibility screen                [exists: viva_equilibrator]
AI-assisted literature extraction with deterministic validators + expert review [to-build: viva_reaction_atlas.extract — every record gated]
KIDA/NIST selective kinetic references (caution: mostly gas-phase/astrochemical, not aqueous-vent)

model_approach.prose: Study 28 is a data-asset build, not a simulation. Records stage through raw/ (observations) and proposed/ (rule-generated or agent-proposed candidates); only records that pass the balance + identity + provenance gate enter the versioned atlas.vN.jsonl. The deterministic validator is the load-bearing piece — mass_balanced and charge_balanced must be true and a source_key present, or the record is rejected. eQuilibrator supplies the ΔG feasibility flag; RDKit canonicalizes structures and enumerates precursors; AI extraction is allowed only behind the deterministic validators and expert review, never as an unchecked source.

tools.role: AI extraction with deterministic chemistry validation + expert review

conditions.name: every_reaction_balanced
conditions.expr: every accepted reaction mass- and charge-balanced (balanced_fraction == 1.0)

conditions.name: every_reaction_sourced
conditions.expr: every accepted reaction carries species identity + source provenance + confidence tier

contract.note: The output is a versioned dataset (workspace/datasets/prebiotic-reaction-atlas/), not a sim trajectory — bounds and source provenance travel with each reaction. Deterministic balance/charge validation runs at write time.

behavior_tests.name: inferred-tier-has-thermo-and-rate-basis
behavior_tests.description: The inferred tier extends connectivity from C1–C3 to functional products only where eQuilibrator ΔG feasibility holds and a justified rate form/range is attached, each flagged is_range with its thermodynamic model recorded — no inferred reaction is promoted without that explicit basis.

measure.detail: fraction of inferred-tier reactions carrying a ΔG feasibility flag + justified rate form/range

pass_if.detail: every inferred reaction has an explicit thermo + rate basis

behavior_tests.name: atlas-write-gate-zero-leakage
behavior_tests.description: No record with mass_balanced=false, charge_balanced=false, or a missing source_key enters atlas.vN.jsonl — the deterministic validator rejects it at write time.

measure.detail: count of unbalanced / unsourced records admitted to atlas.vN.jsonl (target 0)

pass_if.detail: zero balance/provenance violations in the accepted atlas

behavior_tests.name: handoff-28-to-29-complete
behavior_tests.description: The atlas emits the 28→29 transfer bundle — canonical species, balanced stoichiometry, rate forms, parameter bounds and confidence tags — as the typed reaction set study 29 consumes.

measure.detail: presence + typing of every field in the 28→29 transfer bundle

pass_if.detail: bundle complete and typed (satisfies 28→29 handoff validator)

decision_test: A reaction may enter an accepted downstream model only if it exists in the atlas with a balanced equation, canonical species, a source_key (measured/inferred) or an explicit hypothetical flag, and a kinetic domain. Any precursor appearing in a model without a matching atlas record, or any unbalanced reaction, is a blocking failure. Success = coverage of the C1–C3 → functional-chemistry connection at the measured+inferred tiers with zero balance/provenance violations; gaps are reported as gaps (hypothetical tier, or "no defensible pathway"), never filled by lowering the bar (evidence standard #1, #8).

findings.statement: The measured tier reproduces the nonenzymatic metal-promoted carbon-fixation and reverse-Krebs-like segments from the primary literature as balanced, source-keyed records (metal- promoted rTCA sequences; Fe-driven synthesis/breakdown of universal precursors; native-iron CO2 reduction to acetyl-CoA-pathway intermediates).

The inferred tier extends connectivity from C1–C3 to functional products only where eQuilibrator ΔG feasibility holds and a justified rate form/range is attached, each flagged is_range with its thermodynamic model recorded — no inferred reaction is promoted without that explicit basis.

No record with mass_balanced=false, charge_balanced=false, or a missing source_key enters atlas.vN.jsonl — the deterministic validator rejects it at write time. This zero-leakage guarantee is the study's core deliverable.
Candidate energy-coupling and Fe–S / UV-driven steps relevant to downstream energy carriers (study 35) are catalogued with their experimental anchors and confidence tiers.
The atlas emits the 28→29 transfer bundle — canonical species, balanced stoichiometry, rate forms, parameter bounds and confidence tags — as the typed reaction set study 29 consumes.

key_assumptions: Reaction identification, thermodynamic feasibility and kinetic accessibility are three separate gates; a database reaction is not assumed prebiotically viable.
Enzyme-catalysed kinetics (Rhea) do NOT license abiotic kinetic claims.
expert_questions: What confidence-tier rubric and minimum provenance (primary measurement vs. defensible inference) should gate admission to the accepted network?

derived.insight: The measured tier reproduces the nonenzymatic metal-promoted carbon-fixation and reverse-Krebs-like segments from the primary literature as balanced, source-keyed records (metal- promoted rTCA sequences; Fe-driven synthesis/breakdown of universal precursors; native-iron CO2 reduction to acetyl-CoA-pathway intermediates).
